title: Add CI and release publishing baseline

context.summary: Add the public release workflow baseline for checks, Docker image build, release bundle artifacts, checksums and packaged installer smoke validation.
context.background: TASK-70 added public repository hygiene files. The next public-readiness step is a GitHub Actions release path that can produce and validate release artifacts without committing secrets.

in: Add a GitHub Actions release workflow for manual dispatch and v* tags.
Run pnpm check in the release workflow.
Build the Docker image in the release workflow.
Generate release bundle and manifest artifacts.
Run a packaged installer smoke/dry-run against the generated release manifest.
Upload release artifacts to the workflow run and draft GitHub Release for tag builds.
Add local validation for release workflow and release smoke.
Update docs and repository status to describe the release baseline.

acceptance_criteria: The workflow builds a Docker image.
The workflow generates release bundle, manifest and checksum artifacts.
The workflow runs release install smoke without starting Docker.
Tag builds publish release artifacts without repository-stored secrets.
`pnpm release:validate` validates the workflow contract and local release smoke.
Docs describe the release workflow and validation path.

manual_checks: Confirm no real secrets or release signing keys were added.

risks: Release workflow must not depend on private provider credentials.
Release validation must not publish artifacts or mutate a real MINDORY_HOME.
Public docs must not imply signed releases or registry push policy are already complete.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
